new_candidates.body:
**Describe the bug**

Nav2’s Rolling CI started failing with GCC 15 due to a -Wnull-dereference warning coming from `thread_safe_signal.h`. Since we build with `-Werror`, this breaks our BT node builds, and it should hit anyone else downstream compiling with the same flags.

```
In member function 'std::__weak_ptr<_Tp, _Lp>& std::__weak_ptr<_Tp, _Lp>::operator=(const std::__weak_ptr<_Tp, _Lp>&) [with _Tp = BT::ThreadSafeSignal<>::Subscription; ...]',
    ...
    inlined from 'void BT::ThreadSafeSignal<CallableArgs>::notify(CallableArgs ...) [with CallableArgs = {}]' at /opt/ros/rolling/include/behaviortree_cpp/utils/thread_safe_signal.h:52:19:
/usr/include/c++/15/bits/shared_ptr_base.h:2039:7: error: potential null pointer dereference [-Werror=null-dereference]
```

*How to Reproduce**

Compile with `-O2 -Wnull-dereference -Werror`
new_candidates.title: New BT.CPP Build Errors with -Werror

new_candidates.body:
### The feature, motivation and pitch

Currently, users have to manually setup the environment when they want to upgrade or setup anew the MuJoCo library.

I kindly request for the MuJoCo team to start providing official MuJoCo recipes, which can be discovered by pkg-config for automated linking.

Additionally, if possible, it would be nice to have pre-builts hosted in the APT repository and Fedora's DNF repository (a start would be RPM Fusion).
